comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego is the responder and agent1 the initiator; both operate in the same direction on the same trafficway. Chosen assumptions: the faster agent1 approaches from behind in the right lane and makes a leftward lateral evasive action after 1 second, representing avoidance of an unspecified prior hazard. Ego continues following its lane while exposed to the closing incursion. Agent1 uses a 1-2 m target-lane clearance threshold. Speeds are m/s and distances m. Conflict opportunity only; no collision is required.
